text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And then, the Tenno Sho (Autumn) arrived.
Seiun Sky had still not shown up,
even with only five minutes left before roll call.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The resolve to fight is not something to be forced.
That is why I deliberately refrained from going to fetch her this time, but—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much for waiting for me to come out, yes.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well... you know.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I just came up with a neat idea, you see~.
I just can't help but want to try it out in a race.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: So――um.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wanna hear it?
Sei-chan's "break the wall" strategy.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—The hint was right there
in my everyday life with Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. In other words,
against an opponent who constantly surpasses their limits—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Run away at the front, beyond all limits!
That's my only choice!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Tokyo Racecourse has a long home stretch,
so it suits girls like Spe-chan who have a sharp late kick.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
But... what if I push past my limits right there
and hold on at top speed?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You know, I'm thinking of exposing
Sei-chan's little secret right here, but...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I super-duper, totally and utterly
hate losing☆ Kyahan☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you get it, don't you~?
Though everyone around me doesn't really understand.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "To think that beneath Sei-chan's adorable exterior, something is bubbling and boiling over so intensely."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's precisely why—I can be more obsessed with winning than anyone else.
Even enough to not lose to Spe-chan and the others!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Run, run, run—
I'll keep shouting that to myself until the very end...!
choice_data_list: This is going to be fun!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
...I'll make it interesting.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So, well...
Keep your eyes on me and expect great things.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Break down the wall.
I'm gonna go out there and win!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Pull away at the very, very end!
This is the only way!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, everyone makes their move
on the final stretch anyway, don't they?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Which means if I can accelerate again there,
Sei-chan takes the win!
choice_data_list: That's just wishful thinking, isn't it?
That's just wishful thinking, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You'd think so, wouldn't you?
Well, see, I actually went and did it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
For instance... Sei-chan, you've always
been pretty easygoing up until now, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ta-daaa! I'm calling that whole thing off!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll run recklessly, paying no heed to how it looks.
No calculations, no nothing—just showing my true self."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Out of everyone, I'm the one who's hidden her true self the most.
That's why—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I decided to believe until the very end
that I still have some hidden stamina left to squeeze out!
choice_data_list: This is going to be fun!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
...I'll make it interesting.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So, well...
Keep your eyes on me and expect great things.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Break down the wall.
I'm gonna go out there and win!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Pull ahead on the hill!
This is our only chance!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's not a steep grade,
the hill at Tokyo Racecourse is pretty punishing.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
“Still, conditions are the same for everyone. Which means
how much of a lead you can build right there is the whole point!”

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Well, if conditions are the same, talented runners like Spe-chan clearly have the upper hand, no matter how you slice it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
But... so have I.
Using every trick in the book, I've kept climbing this mountain.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yep. A path that felt flat to everyone else
always felt as tough as a mountain to me.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I turned that inferiority complex into fuel
and kept digging deep to win.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, I can't afford to lose
to anyone when it counts.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna pour out all the power I've been saving up... and win this!
choice_data_list: This is going to be fun!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
...I'll make it interesting.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So, well...
Keep your eyes on me and expect great things.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Break down the wall.
I'm gonna go out there and win!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: If you get passed, pass 'em right back! That's the only way!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Even if she bursts out at a great pace, Spe-chan and the others will be right on her tail.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
If you take the lead back right at that moment,
they'll be totally flabbergasted!
choice_data_list: Is something like that even possible?
Is something like that even possible?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You can do it.
After all—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"‘If passed, pass them right back.’
Doesn't that sound just like Sei-chan's way of life?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've been overtaken more times than anyone else.
Because I had neither talent nor strength...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So use your head, think it all the way through.
If you get passed, pass them back. If you get passed again... don't give up, pass them back once more.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That was my only path to victory.
So all I had to do was push it to the absolute limit.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: That is my... stubborn pride.
choice_data_list: This is going to be fun!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
...I'll make it interesting.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So, well...
Keep your eyes on me and expect great things.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Break down the wall.
I'm gonna go out there and win!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Sniping the strongest rival!
That's our only move!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"When it comes down to it, the opponent I need to be
most wary of is already pretty obvious, isn't it~?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Which means, if Sei-chan can just throw her off so she can't make a move, 1st place will be mine☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
“What are the requirements to be a winner? Ability? Talent?
Luck of the draw? No, it's none of those.”

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
――Whether you were the very first one
to cross the finish line or not. That's all that matters.
choice_data_list: This is Seiun Sky's time to shine.
Time for Sky to show what she can do!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yup, exactly☆
And that's the start of Sei-chan's Magic Show!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Pull off a bluff big enough to make the opponent hesitate at the critical moment...
and sprint right past them in the meantime."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Right, use your head. This—this alone is what
I've spent all this time honing—"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Because it's my weapon.
choice_data_list: This is going to be fun!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
...I'll make it interesting.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So, well...
Keep your eyes on me and expect great things.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Break down the wall.
I'm gonna go out there and win!"
